g.text: IFAD: 175 IF2 + 400 Adam iterations. ADPF: alpha 1, 425 Adam iterations, no IF2 initialization.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: IFAD times in D and E include IF2 initialization and failed iterations. Dynamax times include compilation within SSM.fit_sgd.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Boxplots and medians use all finite log likelihood estimates. Failed fits use the last valid parameters where available; seven fits produced no finite likelihood estimate.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Triangles in A and B indicate estimates below -3,835. The second figure shows the full range. Each point is one run; replicates in B and C share an initial value.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Total time: 49.12 GPU h and 14.50 CPU core h, including PFJAX likelihood reevaluation. Preliminary tests are excluded. Timing depends on implementation, batching and compilation.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Likelihood evaluation uses the original PyPOMP PF: J=5,000, R=36 for A, up to R=288 for B/C. Evaluation random numbers are independent of optimization; CPU methods share paired numbers.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6d7c

g.text: Package denotes code supplied by the library; custom denotes code added for this study. ADPF uses differentiable PF likelihoods with Adam. Package PF does not imply a package parameter-estimation method.
